l0.speaker: narrator
l0.text: You walk into the main quad to the smell fresh textbook pages, overpriced espresso, and pure, unfiltered anxiety.

l0_1.speaker: narrator
l0_1.text: Welcome to Runtime University, where your academic future is bright, your sleep schedule is bleak, and your romantic destiny is directly tied to your GPA.

l1.speaker: narrator
l1.text: After sitting through a grueling welcome speech by President Fortran, you are handed a welcome bag and shuffled off into a tour group.

l1_1.speaker: narrator
l1_1.text: In your welcome bag you find a lanyard, a campus map, a calendar of events, and a small yellow rubber duck.

l2.speaker: quack
l2.text: Hi! I'm Quack Overflow. Quack for short. Every student gets a rubber duck, and you got the best one.

name.speaker: quack
name.text: Wait, where are my manners? I introduced myself and didn't even ask who you are. What's your name?

nice.speaker: quack
nice.text: {player}! Great name. Very readable. Nice to meet you, {player}.

l3.speaker: quack
l3.text: When your code breaks, you explain it to me, line by line, and suddenly you'll see the bug. It's called rubber duck debugging. I also give hints.

l3_0.speaker: quack
l3_0.text: When your love life feels like confusing, I'll give you relationship advice! Not that I've ever been in a relationship.

l4.speaker: quack
l4.text: I'm one day old. It's my birthday! Where's my cake?

ask.speaker: quack
ask.text: Okay, {player}, important question. Why did you pick computer science?

choices.text: I'm curious how computers actually work.
I panicked on the application form.

games.speaker: quack
games.text: A game dev! Then you'll want to meet the people in the Hopper Computer Lab. Well, one of them. You'll know who.

money.speaker: quack
money.text: Respect. Rent is real. Good news: every line of code you write here is an investment.

curious.speaker: quack
curious.text: Ooh, a curious one. Careful, that's how you end up reading compiler source code at 3 a.m.

panicked.speaker: quack
panicked.text: Ha! Same. I panicked my way into being a duck. It worked out great.

calendar.speaker: quack
calendar.text: Okay, the calendar. Every day has two free slots, Day and Night. You can spend them on extracurriculars, office hours, tutoring, and just generally getting to know people.

events.speaker: quack
events.text: Special events pop up during the semester, like the club fair and the fall carnival. They're all marked on your calendar. It's the button next to Menu, so check it often!

map.speaker: quack
map.text: Then there's the map. Pick a place, see who's there, and spend some time with them.

tour.speaker: quack
tour.text: First, the campus tour! I'll show you around. Who knows, maybe you'll meet someone interesting.
